column1: # prompt|correct response|distractor|distractor|skill|explanation. Even rows practice, odd rows held out across mocks 02–04.
Where should I leave the empty crates?|Behind the receiving desk.|They were delivered yesterday.|About six kilograms.|地點與方向|where 詢問放置地點，回答收貨櫃檯後方。
Where can I collect my visitor badge?|The security officer has it.|My visit lasted an hour.|I collected stamps as a child.|地點與方向|透過負責保管的人間接指出領取地點。
Where is the nearest cash machine?|Across from the pharmacy.|Cash payments are welcome.|The machine prints labels.|地點與方向|across from 指在藥局對面。
Where do we store signed contracts?|In the locked cabinet upstairs.|We signed them together.|A temporary position.|地點與方向|signed contracts 是已簽署合約，回答存放的櫃子。
Where will the safety demonstration take place?|They haven't chosen a room yet.|Please take a spare helmet.|It demonstrates our commitment.|間接應答|尚未選定房間，合理回應活動地點未定。
Where did you park the delivery van?|Beside the service entrance.|The delivery was free.|I usually drive to work.|地點與方向|問貨車停在哪裡，回答服務入口旁。
Where can guests refill their water bottles?|There's a dispenser near the stairs.|We ordered bottled water.|The guests arrived early.|地點與方向|dispenser 是飲水設備，回答其位置。
Where is the missing tool kit?|Try asking the maintenance team.|The kit has several tools.|Missing the bus was frustrating.|間接應答|建議詢問維修團隊，間接協助找工具箱。
Where should we display the revised timetable?|On the noticeboard by the lift.|The train leaves at eight.|We revised it twice.|地點與方向|詢問張貼時刻表的位置。
Where can I get a copy of the presentation?|I'll send you the download link.|The presentation was excellent.|Please get some fresh coffee.|間接應答|提供下載連結即可取得簡報，不必直接回答實體地點。
When does the evening reception begin?|Right after the final workshop.|At the reception desk.|The receptionist is new.|時間與日期|when 問時間，after 指工作坊結束後。
When will the new shipment arrive?|The carrier hasn't confirmed a date.|We ship worldwide.|The ship is quite large.|間接應答|物流商尚未確認日期，回答到貨時間未知。
When should I turn off the display lights?|Once the last visitor leaves.|The display is on the left.|They're energy efficient.|時間與日期|once 引導最後一位訪客離開時的條件時間。
When is the application deadline?|It's been extended by a week.|Please apply more pressure.|The line was very long.|間接應答|說明截止期限已延長，與申請時間相關。
When can we inspect the renovated office?|Any afternoon next week.|The office has three windows.|A property inspection report.|時間與日期|回答下週任一下午皆可。
When did the equipment stop working?|Shortly before the power cut.|It works very quietly.|Please stop at the entrance.|時間與日期|shortly before 表示停電前不久。
When will the revised menu be printed?|As soon as the chef approves it.|I'd like the soup, please.|The printer is beside me.|時間與日期|as soon as 引導主廚核准之後的時間。
When are you meeting the architect?|I'm still waiting for her reply.|The building has six floors.|We met through a friend.|間接應答|仍在等回覆，表示會面時間尚未確定。
When should we replace the filters?|The maintenance schedule lists the dates.|The filter removed the dust.|A replacement was expensive.|間接應答|指出可查詢更換日期的維護時程。
When did the morning train leave?|You just missed it.|From platform four.|Please leave the door open.|間接應答|you just missed it 表示列車剛剛離開。
Who is leading the orientation session?|The training coordinator.|At the main entrance.|The session lasts an hour.|人物與職責|who 問負責人，回答訓練協調員。
Who can authorize this refund?|You'll need to speak to the manager.|The amount is on the receipt.|I paid by bank transfer.|人物與職責|經理有授權退款的職責。
Who borrowed the folding ladder?|I saw the electrician using it.|The ladder folds flat.|Borrowing is free for members.|間接應答|看到電工使用，提供借用者的線索。
Who designed the new brochure?|An agency we worked with last year.|It will be printed tomorrow.|The design uses blue ink.|人物與職責|回答去年合作過的設計公司。
Who should receive the damaged parcel?|Give it to the returns clerk.|It arrived damaged.|A parcel of land.|人物與職責|退貨承辦人負責接收受損包裹。
Who is available to interpret at the meeting?|I'll check the volunteer list.|The meeting is upstairs.|An interesting interpretation.|間接應答|需查志工名單，表示尚未確定口譯人員。
Who ordered the extra display stands?|The exhibition organizer did.|They're standing near the wall.|Please order before noon.|人物與職責|did 代替 ordered，回答展覽主辦人。
Who will take over your shift tomorrow?|My supervisor is arranging cover.|The shift ends at six.|I took the bus instead.|間接應答|cover 在此指代班人員，主管正安排中。
Who keeps the key to the supply room?|Ask the office administrator.|We supply local restaurants.|The keyboard is wireless.|人物與職責|指出辦公室行政人員可處理鑰匙問題。
Who approved the change in layout?|It was a joint decision.|The layout is much clearer.|Please change at the next stop.|間接應答|joint decision 表示共同決定，回答核准者並非單一人。
Why was the loading dock closed?|A vehicle was blocking the entrance.|It closes at five.|The load was too heavy.|原因與目的|貨車阻擋入口是關閉裝卸區的原因。
Why are the tickets being reissued?|The venue has changed.|I booked mine online.|The issue was discussed.|原因與目的|場地變更，因此重新發行票券。
Why did you choose the earlier flight?|It leaves time for the afternoon meeting.|At the departure gate.|The airline has a new logo.|原因與目的|選早班機是為了趕上下午會議。
Why hasn't the invoice been paid?|We're waiting for a corrected total.|I paid for lunch.|The voice was very clear.|原因與目的|正等候更正金額，解釋尚未付款原因。
Why is the gallery so quiet today?|It's closed to the public on Mondays.|Please speak quietly.|The paintings are valuable.|原因與目的|週一不對外開放，因此人少安靜。
Why were additional tables ordered?|Registration exceeded our estimate.|They are made of wood.|Please put the order on the table.|原因與目的|報名人數超過預估，需要更多桌子。
Why did the supplier reject the sample?|The color didn't match the specification.|The sample arrived by courier.|A rejection letter.|原因與目的|顏色不符合規格是拒收樣品的原因。
Why is the hallway being repainted?|The old coating was peeling.|The painter arrives tomorrow.|It's beside the main hall.|原因與目的|原有塗層剝落，需要重新油漆。
Why do we need two copies of the form?|One stays with the customer.|The copier is out of paper.|Please form a line.|原因與目的|其中一份留給顧客，說明需要兩份的用途。
Why was the workshop postponed?|The instructor lost her voice.|It covers basic photography.|The posters are ready.|原因與目的|講師失聲，因此延後工作坊。
How can I reset my access code?|Use the link in the welcome email.|The code has six digits.|Access is restricted.|方法與流程|how 問操作方式，回答使用郵件連結。
How do we request a vegetarian meal?|Add a note to the booking form.|The vegetables are fresh.|The meal was delicious.|方法與流程|在訂位表註明素食需求。
How will the chairs be transported?|The rental company has a truck.|There are thirty chairs.|Please take a seat.|方法與流程|用出租公司的卡車運送，回答運輸方式。
How should I report a faulty light?|Send a photo to facilities.|The report is very detailed.|Turn left at the lights.|方法與流程|傳照片給設施管理部門是報修方法。
How did you hear about the opening?|A former colleague recommended it.|The door was left open.|I can hear you clearly.|方法與流程|問得知職缺的管道，回答前同事推薦。
How do members renew their passes?|They can do it through the website.|The pass is blue.|Our newest member.|方法與流程|網站提供會員證續期功能。
How can we reduce printing costs?|Try using both sides of the paper.|The printer costs a lot.|The paper arrived yesterday.|方法與流程|雙面列印是降低成本的具體建議。
How are fragile items packed?|With padding between each piece.|The package is on the desk.|It was a fragile agreement.|方法與流程|物品之間放緩衝材，回答包裝方式。
How do I join the waiting list?|Reception can add your name.|I've been waiting all morning.|The list is alphabetical.|方法與流程|櫃檯可登記姓名，回答候補登記方法。
How did the demonstration go?|Better than we expected.|Please go through this door.|It's going to rain.|進度與評價|how did it go 問進行情況，回答比預期好。
How much is the delivery charge?|It's included in the quoted price.|The driver delivered it.|Please charge the battery.|數量與費用|運费已包含在報價中，無另列金額。
How many headsets do we need?|One for each participant.|The set begins at seven.|I need to head home.|數量與費用|每位參加者一副，回答數量的計算方式。
How long will the inspection take?|Allow about forty minutes.|The inspector is quite tall.|We inspected the long corridor.|期間與頻率|how long 問所需時間，回答約四十分鐘。
How often are the alarms tested?|On the first Monday of every month.|The alarm was loud.|Testing was successful.|期間與頻率|how often 問頻率，回答每月第一個星期一。
How far is the conference center?|It's a short walk from the station.|The conference lasts two days.|The center of the page.|距離與交通|a short walk 表示距離車站不遠。
How much storage space is available?|Let me check the floor plan.|Please store it upright.|The spacing looks uneven.|間接應答|需要查平面圖才能回答可用空間。
How many applicants have confirmed?|Only half of them so far.|The application is online.|Confirmation is required.|數量與費用|回答目前只有一半申請者確認。
How long have you worked at this branch?|Since it opened three years ago.|The branch closes at six.|It's a long road.|期間與頻率|since 回答從三年前開幕起任職至今。
How often should the plants be watered?|Check the label on each pot.|The water is cold.|The plant manufactures parts.|期間與頻率|每盆標籤載有澆水頻率，指引查詢來源。
How far in advance should we reserve a room?|At least two weeks.|The room is at the far end.|Our reserves are limited.|期間與頻率|問需提前多久預訂，回答至少兩週。
Could you proofread this announcement?|Sure, after I finish this email.|The announcement was yesterday.|A waterproof cover.|請求與回應|答應幫忙，並說明完成目前工作後才可開始。
Would you mind moving these boxes?|Not at all. Where should they go?|The boxes are made of cardboard.|I've changed my mind.|請求與回應|not at all 在此表示不介意，接著詢問搬到哪裡。
Can you cover the information desk at noon?|I have an appointment then.|The desk is covered with leaflets.|Noon is midday.|間接拒絕|說明當時有約，間接表示無法代班。
Could you send the invoice again?|Which email address should I use?|The invoice is overdue.|I sent a postcard.|請求與回應|確認寄送地址，表示願意重新寄送。
Would you help me test the microphone?|Let me finish this call first.|The test results were good.|A microphone stand.|請求與回應|願意幫忙但要先結束通話。
Can you print the name badges?|We're almost out of ink.|My name is on the list.|I prefer the blue badge.|間接應答|墨水快用完，指出無法立即列印的障礙。
Could you hold the door for a moment?|Of course, take your time.|The door opens inward.|A moment of silence.|請求與回應|答應幫忙扶門。
Would you check the route before we leave?|I've already downloaded the map.|The bus leaves from here.|The check was signed.|間接應答|已下載地圖，表示已為路線確認做準備。
Can you stay until the last delivery arrives?|I'll need to rearrange my transport.|Delivery is usually free.|The last item on the menu.|請求與回應|可否留下涉及返家交通安排，屬合理條件回應。
Could you lend me a stapler?|There's one in the top drawer.|The loan was approved.|A staple food.|請求與回應|提供釘書機的位置，間接答應借用。
Shall we move the meeting outside?|The forecast says it may rain.|The meeting was productive.|Please move the cursor.|建議與回應|指出可能下雨，回應戶外開會的提議。
Why don't we ask for a second quotation?|That's worth trying.|Because the quote was famous.|The second floor.|建議與回應|why don't we 是提出建議，回答值得一試。
How about using the smaller room?|Will it fit all twelve of us?|The room is painted white.|I use it every day.|建議與回應|針對提案確認空間是否容納得下所有人。
Let's order the replacement parts today.|I'll check the part numbers first.|The order is alphabetical.|Today is Wednesday.|建議與回應|訂購前先核對零件編號是合理的下一步。
Would you like to join the walking tour?|Is there still a place available?|I walk to work.|The tourists took photos.|邀請與回應|確認是否還有名額，間接表達有興趣參加。
Shall I book a table near the window?|Somewhere quieter would be better.|The windows were cleaned.|A booking reference.|建議與回應|表達較希望安靜座位的偏好。
Why don't we postpone the photo shoot?|The photographer is only free today.|The photos are colorful.|I prefer digital cameras.|間接拒絕|攝影師只有今天有空，表示不適合延期。
How about sharing a taxi to the venue?|I'm leaving from a different office.|The taxi is yellow.|Sharing is encouraged.|間接拒絕|出發地不同，解釋無法方便共乘。
Let's check the figures one more time.|Good idea; the totals don't match.|The figure is made of wood.|It's time for lunch.|建議與回應|總額不符，所以同意再核對。
Would you like a printed program?|The digital version is enough, thanks.|The program begins at two.|We printed a hundred.|邀請與回應|已有電子版，禮貌拒絕紙本。
Do you prefer a morning or afternoon appointment?|Whichever is available sooner.|The appointment was cancelled.|Yes, I prefer.|選擇問句|表示選擇較早有空的時段，兩者都可。
Should the notice go on the door or the website?|Both, if possible.|The door is open.|Yes, it should.|選擇問句|回答兩個公告管道都採用。
Will you collect the parcel or have it delivered?|I'll pick it up on my way home.|It was a pleasant trip.|A collection of essays.|選擇問句|pick it up 表示自行領取，對應第一個選項。
Is the training online or in the classroom?|The invitation has the details.|Class begins soon.|Yes, it is.|間接應答|指出可確認上課方式的邀請函。
Would you rather review the budget now or after lunch?|Let's get it done now.|Lunch is in the cafeteria.|The budget is balanced.|選擇問句|回答現在就完成，對應第一個選項。
Are we taking the train or the company van?|The rail service is suspended today.|The company is expanding.|Yes, we are taking.|間接應答|列車今日停駛，間接排除火車選項。
Do you want the receipt by email or on paper?|Email would be easier to keep.|The paper is recycled.|I've received it already.|選擇問句|選擇較方便保存的電子郵件收據。
Should I speak to sales or technical support?|It sounds like a technical issue.|Sales increased last year.|The speaker is upstairs.|選擇問句|屬技術問題，因此應聯絡技術支援。
Is the broken sensor being repaired or replaced?|A new one arrived this morning.|The repair shop is closed.|Yes, the sensor is.|間接應答|新感應器已到，表示採取更換方式。
Would you prefer a refund or store credit?|I'd like the money returned to my card.|The store is near the station.|My credit is good.|選擇問句|要求退回信用卡款項，對應退款。
Didn't you receive the updated schedule?|It may have gone to my old address.|The schedule is very full.|An excellent reception.|否定與附加問句|提供可能未收到更新時程的原因。
Isn't the east entrance closed today?|It's open again now.|Please close the file.|The entrance fee is low.|否定與附加問句|說明東入口目前已重新開放。
Haven't we met at a trade fair?|Yes, at the lighting exhibition.|The weather was fair.|I bought a ticket.|否定與附加問句|確認曾在照明展見面。
Didn't the supplier promise free delivery?|Only for orders above the minimum amount.|The delivery driver is friendly.|I promise to be careful.|否定與附加問句|補充免運門檻，澄清承諾的條件。
Isn't your office moving next month?|The move has been delayed.|The office is spacious.|Please don't move.|否定與附加問句|搬遷已延期，更新原本預期。
The figures have been checked, haven't they?|The accountant is reviewing them now.|They're in the third column.|A bank check.|否定與附加問句|仍在審核中，間接表示尚未核對完。
You're presenting after the break, aren't you?|My session was moved to tomorrow.|The presentation has slides.|The chair isn't broken.|否定與附加問句|說明自己的場次已改至明天。
This pass covers the return trip, doesn't it?|No, it's a single ticket.|The cover is waterproof.|Return the form, please.|否定與附加問句|單程票不包含回程。
We don't need to reserve seats, do we?|The organizer strongly recommends it.|These seats are comfortable.|The reserve is beautiful.|否定與附加問句|主辦方強烈建議預約座位。
The report is confidential, isn't it?|Please keep it within the team.|The conference was useful.|It's on recycled paper.|否定與附加問句|要求只限團隊內閱覽，間接確認保密性。
The projector won't connect to my laptop.|Try the spare cable in the case.|The project is almost finished.|I connected with an old friend.|陳述句應答|提供更換連接線的具體排除方式。
I can't read the text on this sign.|I'll ask for a larger print version.|The sign was approved.|I read it last week.|陳述句應答|字太小看不清楚，提供大字版協助。
The courier came while we were at lunch.|There's a collection notice on the desk.|Lunch was excellent.|A course in accounting.|陳述句應答|指出未遇到快遞後留下的領取通知。
Our usual supplier is out of stock.|Let's contact the alternative vendor.|The stock market rose.|I usually arrive early.|陳述句應答|缺貨時尋找替代供應商。
The meeting room is already occupied.|The training room should be free.|The meeting was yesterday.|I'm occupied with a report.|陳述句應答|提供可能有空的替代會議空間。
I left my access card at home.|Security can issue a temporary pass.|The card has a photograph.|I prefer to work at home.|陳述句應答|忘帶門禁卡，可找警衛申請臨時通行證。
These boxes are too heavy for one person.|I'll bring the trolley.|A box of paper clips.|The person is waiting.|陳述句應答|用推車解決重物搬運問題。
The customer requested a different fabric.|Has the order gone into production yet?|The customer paid in full.|A different point of view.|陳述句應答|先確認是否已投產，以評估能否改材料。
I haven't finished checking the references.|We can delay publication until Friday.|A reference book.|The finish is very smooth.|陳述句應答|尚未完成查證，因此可延後出版。
The delivery address on this label is wrong.|Don't send the parcel yet.|The label is printed clearly.|I delivered a speech.|陳述句應答|地址錯誤時先暫停寄送。
Are there any seats left for the lecture?|I'll check the booking system.|The seats are wooden.|The lecturer left early.|間接應答|需要查訂位系統才能確認剩餘座位。
Has the inspection report been submitted?|The supervisor still needs to sign it.|The report has twelve pages.|I inspect the area daily.|間接應答|尚待主管簽名，暗示還未送出。
Can we use the loading bay this afternoon?|A truck will be there until three.|The bay is very scenic.|This afternoon was sunny.|間接應答|告知裝卸區占用到三點，提供可用時間條件。
Do you know the new assistant's extension?|Her number is in the staff directory.|The extension was built recently.|I know the building well.|間接應答|員工通訊錄可查分機。
Has anyone contacted the venue manager?|I left a message this morning.|The venue holds two hundred.|The manager is experienced.|間接應答|已留言，表示有人聯絡過。
Is the replacement covered by the warranty?|We need to check the purchase date.|The cover is removable.|The replacement looks good.|間接應答|保固是否有效取決於購買日期。
Are you ready to approve the design?|I'd like to see a physical sample first.|The designer is ready.|Approval is important.|間接應答|想先看實體樣品，表示尚未準備核准。
Did the new payment terminal arrive?|It's still in transit.|I paid in cash.|The terminal is crowded.|間接應答|in transit 表示仍在運送途中。
Can visitors take photographs inside?|Only in the public gallery.|The photographs are framed.|Visitors came from abroad.|條件與限制|僅限公共展廳可拍照，屬有條件允許。
Is parking included with the room?|Ask reception to validate your ticket.|The room is on the fifth floor.|I parked carefully.|間接應答|請櫃檯處理停車票驗證，提供停車優惠的處理方式。
Which file contains the final artwork?|Use the one marked approved.|The artist is talented.|A filing cabinet.|選擇與辨識|標示 approved 的檔案是核准定稿。
Which entrance is accessible without steps?|The path by the garden is level.|The steps were painted.|Access begins at nine.|選擇與辨識|花園旁平坦的路徑對應無階梯入口。
Which supplier offers the shortest lead time?|Compare the delivery column on the sheet.|The lead singer.|The supplier is local.|間接應答|交貨時間欄可比較最短前置時間。
Which version should be translated?|Wait for the editor's final changes.|The translation is accurate.|I speak two languages.|間接應答|須等編輯完成修改，再確定翻譯版本。
Which bus goes to the science park?|The express route stops there.|The park has tall trees.|The bus is clean.|選擇與辨識|指出快捷公車路線有停靠科學園區。
Which candidate has accepted the offer?|Human resources hasn't told us yet.|The offer is generous.|I accept your apology.|間接應答|人資尚未告知錄取接受情況。
Which room should we use for the interview?|Choose one away from the construction noise.|The interview went well.|A room with blue chairs.|選擇與辨識|以遠離施工噪音作為面試空間的選擇條件。
Which device needs a software update?|The tablet at the front desk.|I updated the report.|The software is easy to use.|選擇與辨識|回答櫃檯的平板需要更新。
Which documents should I bring to the appointment?|The confirmation email lists everything.|The documents are signed.|Bring a friend next time.|間接應答|確認郵件列出所需文件。
Which of these samples matches the order?|Let me compare them with the specification.|The samples are free.|A matching jacket.|間接應答|需對照規格才能確認正確樣品。
Would it be possible to extend the rental?|The equipment is reserved for another client tomorrow.|The rental office is modern.|It's a possible solution.|間接拒絕|隔天已有其他人預約，暗示無法延租。
Could we receive the files before the weekend?|I'll mark the request as urgent.|The weekend was relaxing.|I received your card.|請求與回應|標示急件以處理週末前取得檔案的需求。
